title: Pixel Index layout metadata
description: Describes one community layout. Kept out of layout.json so that file stays byte-for-byte what Pixel Agents imports. Layouts are not licensed individually — the repository is MIT licensed as a whole.

title.description: Display name shown in the gallery.

author.description: Who made the layout. A GitHub username is ideal.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the layout is for.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case keywords used for filtering.

source.description: Optional link to the original design, thread, or inspiration.
